notes: The supplier-published images are complete frame reference photographs, not seamless textures or production overlays. The renderer uses rail-surface crops extracted from those references, repeated within deterministic mitred rail geometry. Bevel highlights and contact shadows are procedural visual approximations and are not supplier-supplied textures.

finishes.processing: Cropped a clean surface section from the top rail, resampled it to a reusable 1024 x 96 PNG strip, and rotated that strip for vertical grain direction.
